== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|Mariala Brechess is a professional fortune mage and a human woman who possesses [[half-Aethril]] heritage. This lineage manifests in her black hair, which contains sparkling silver spots resembling stars that glow when she interacts with the [[Aether]], and grants her a natural sensitivity to magical currents. Though she appears much younger than her actual age in her thirties, she is a highly trained magic user who has spent decades honing her skills. She carries specialized equipment, including a protective [[amulet]] and a destructive blazing rod. As a student of magic, Mariala serves as the leader and spokesperson for a group of five professional mages who left their previous lives to follow a professor in hopes of advancing their magical abilities. Her personal ambitions involve using her magic to secure a political role within Planetary [[Security]], which she believes would allow her to rectify injustices within the Brechess family. However, after leaving the [[Magic Tower]] and the [[Galactic Union]], she and her companions become fugitives. Throughout her travels, Mariala demonstrates a keen analytical mind, often identifying weaknesses in magical defenses and recording observations to improve her craft.}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|Mariala is a young human woman who is suspected to be [[half-Aethril]]. She has black hair and eyes that drift as if they are watching the [[Aether]], and she also possesses an [[optical implant]].}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=lh-04-the-pilot|As a certified [[wizard]] from the [[Magic Tower]], Mariala specializes in [[fortune magic]] and can see the future through [[Aetheric symbols]]. She is capable of casting offensive spells, preparing magic in advance, and utilizes a [[wand]], a tablet and stylus, or a blazing rod with a destructive [[aura]].}}
